name: RTS — Ban / Timeout Widget
description: Turn moderation into an event with a cinematic ban animation, independent timeout cells, configurable positioning, sizing, messages, and a proper event queue.

setup.title: Get the extension running.
setup.intro: Import the Streamer.bot actions, enable them, add the overlay to OBS, then test the extension.

steps.title: Import the Streamer.bot actions
steps.description: Open Streamer.bot and use Import to paste the supplied import string, or download the exact versioned import file.

substeps.title: Open Import
substeps.text: Select Import from the Streamer.bot toolbar.

images.alt: Streamer.bot import screen showing the RTS extension import code

substeps.title: Paste the import code
substeps.text: Paste the supplied import string into the Import String box, then select Import.

substeps.title: Confirm the import
substeps.text: Review the actions being imported, then select Import to continue.

steps.title: Enable the imported actions
steps.description: Enable the imported RTS actions so the extension can respond to events.

substeps.title: Enable the extension actions
substeps.text: Enable the imported RTS actions in Streamer.bot.

images.alt: Streamer.bot imported RTS actions being enabled

substeps.title: Check the commands
substeps.text: Confirm the imported extension commands are present and enabled where required.

images.alt: Streamer.bot commands showing the imported RTS extension commands

steps.title: Add the extension overlay to OBS
steps.description: Add the extension's hosted overlay URL as an OBS Browser Source, or use the supplied local overlay files.

steps.title: Test the extension
steps.description: Run a test event and confirm the overlay responds correctly before putting it live.

dllInformation.title: DLL information
dllInformation.text: This extension requires RTS UI DLL 0.1.0 or newer.
